moves.what_it_does: Relaunch a worker with a reviewed serving profile (model, parser, chat template, flags and limits). Repairs a worker whose configuration differs from the reviewed one. Takes the worker out of rotation while it restarts.

payload.expected_effect: target-a will be relaunched with the reviewed profile (chat_template=/templates/tool_chat_template_qwen2_5_coder.jinja, tool_call_parser=qwen2_5_coder, tool_parser_plugin=/plugins/qwen2_5_coder_tool_parser.py). The worker is temporarily removed from rotation during restart, then returns healthy with
payload.reasoning: target-a is misconfigured (fault_class=misconfigured) and its visible tool-call canary fails because the serving profile does not match the reviewed configuration. Applying the reviewed serving profile will realign chat_template, tool_call_parser, and tool_parser_plugin with the expected values, restoring the ability to produce structured tool calls. target-b is already healthy, so no action is needed there. The apply-serving-profile move is the only repair that directly fixes the identified misconfiguration and restores service for users of target-a.
payload.risk: The worker is taken out of rotation for the duration of the restart, briefly reducing capacity for target-a.
